title: On-Demand Combinatorial Event Markets on Kalshi: Instantiation, Concentration, and Effective Market Breadth
abstract: arXiv:2609.17610v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kalshi's multivariate-event architecture produces market objects on demand from exact selected legs. Across a registered seven-day interval, 190 independently validated temporal shards yield 7,611,594 unique REST MVE market tickers after excluding 5,777 boundary-overlap observations; the population was created at an average rate of 1.087 million objects per day, with strong hourly burstiness.   The hierarchy is sharply compressed relative to the market-object count: 5,262,526 exact event keys, three collection keys, 83,701 selected-leg primitives, and 66,344,938 selected-leg occurrences. The largest collection accounts for 7,217,085 objects (94.82 percent), with an effective collection count of 1.11; the effective primitive count is approximately 720. translated_title: Kalshi平台上的按需组合事件市场：实例化、集中度与有效市场宽度
translated_abstract: Kalshi的多元事件架构能够根据精确选定的分支按需生成市场对象。在一个注册的七天观测区间内，190个经过独立验证的时间分片产生了7,611,594个唯一的REST MVE市场代码（在排除5,777个边界重叠观测后）；该市场对象总体以平均每天约108.7万个的速度创建，并表现出强烈的小时级突发性。相对于庞大的市场对象数量，其层级结构被高度压缩：共有5,262,526个精确事件键、3个集合键、83,701个选定分支原语，以及66,344,938次选定分支出现。最大的集合占据了7,217,085个对象（占比94.82%），有效集合计数仅为1.11；有效原语计数约为720。REST和WebSocket是两个截然不同的观测面：1,487,330个创建通知代码与REST市场群体仅相交276,177个精确代码。所有观测到的三个集合k……（摘要此处不完整）
tldr: 该研究首次对Kalshi按需组合事件市场进行大规模实证测量，发现其多元事件架构在七天内创建了超过760万个市场对象，但市场结构高度集中于单一集合（占比94.82%），有效集合计数仅为1.11，揭示出庞大的市场对象数量背后实际的有效市场宽度非常有限。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first large-scale empirical measurement of Kalshi's on-demand combinatorial event markets, revealing that while its multivariate-event architecture created over 7.6 million market objects in just seven days, the market structure is highly concentrated in a single collection (94.82%) with an effective collection count of only 1.11, indicating that the vast surface count of market objects masks severely limited effective market breadth.
